stages.title: ARTICLE 79 ARCHITECTURE, COMPOSITION AND REPRESENTATION

pills.text: ARTICLE 79 CREATES ONE PARLIAMENT FROM THE PRESIDENT AND TWO DIFFERENTLY CONSTITUTED HOUSES.
PRESIDENT + LOK SABHA + RAJYA SABHA COMBINE ASSENT, POPULAR MANDATE AND FEDERAL REVISION.
PRESIDENT IS INTEGRAL TO PARLIAMENT BUT IS NOT A MEMBER OF EITHER HOUSE.
EXAM USE: THIS DESIGN COMBINES POPULAR AUTHORITY, FEDERAL REVISION AND CONSTITUTIONAL FORM.

sequence: Article 79 creates one Parliament from the President and two differently constituted Houses.
President + Lok Sabha + Rajya Sabha combine assent, popular mandate and federal revision.
President is integral to Parliament but is not a member of either House.

stages.title: MEMBERSHIP, DISQUALIFICATION, VACANCIES AND OPPOSITION

QUALIFICATION, VACANCY, ECI OPINION AND PRESIDING-OFFICER RECOGNITION KEEP MEMBERSHIP LEGALLY CONTROLLED.
THE 1977 ACT HAS NO TEN-PERCENT LOP THRESHOLD; DO NOT CONFUSE PRACTICE WITH STATUTORY TEXT.
EXAM USE: DIFFERENT MANDATES EXPLAIN LATER DIFFERENCES IN FINANCE, CONFIDENCE AND FEDERAL REVISION.

sequence: Articles 84, 101-103 regulate entry, continuity and disqualification; the 1977 Act governs LoP recognition.
Qualification, vacancy, ECI opinion and presiding-officer recognition keep membership legally controlled.

stages.title: SESSIONS, SITTINGS, QUORUM AND ACCOUNTABILITY DEVICES

pills.text: ARTICLE 85 GUARANTEES RECURRENCE, WHILE HOUSE RULES TURN SITTINGS INTO QUESTIONING AND DEBATE.
SUMMONING ENABLES QUESTIONS AND MOTIONS, BUT NO CONSTITUTIONAL MINIMUM SITTING-DAY FLOOR EXISTS.
BUDGET, MONSOON AND WINTER ARE CONVENTIONS, NOT CONSTITUTIONALLY FIXED SESSIONS.
EXAM USE: THESE ROUTES PROTECT LEGISLATIVE INTEGRITY WITHOUT MERGING ELECTION PETITIONS AND VACANCY RULES.

DEPUTY SPEAKER VACANCY SINCE MAY 2019 IS A DATED FACT, NOT A CONSTITUTIONAL RULE.
EXAM USE: CORRECT TIME VOCABULARY DETERMINES WHETHER BUSINESS SURVIVES AND ACCOUNTABILITY CAN RECUR.

stages.title: ORDINARY LEGISLATION AND THE BILL-CLASS FIREWALL

pills.text: BILL CLASSIFICATION DETERMINES ORIGIN, RECOMMENDATION, UPPER-HOUSE POWER, DEADLOCK AND ASSENT.
CORRECT CLASSIFICATION CHANNELS EACH BILL THROUGH THE CONSTITUTIONALLY ASSIGNED LEGISLATIVE ROUTE.
A FINANCIAL BILL-I IS NOT A MONEY BILL; RAJYA SABHA RETAINS FULL LEGISLATIVE POWER.
EXAM USE: THE DEVICES SPAN DISCLOSURE, DEBATE, CENSURE, FINANCIAL PRESSURE AND GOVERNMENT REMOVAL.

sequence: Bill classification determines origin, recommendation, Upper-House power, deadlock and assent.
Correct classification channels each Bill through the constitutionally assigned legislative route.
A Financial Bill-I is not a Money Bill; Rajya Sabha retains full legislative power.

stages.title: JOINT SITTING, LAPSE AND ORDINANCE RETURN

pills.text: ARTICLES 108, 111 AND 123 CONNECT DEADLOCK, ASSENT, DISSOLUTION AND TEMPORARY EXECUTIVE LAWMAKING.
JOINT SITTING RESOLVES ELIGIBLE DEADLOCKS; DISSOLUTION SELECTIVELY LAPSES BILLS; ORDINANCES RETURN TO PARLIAMENT.
MONEY AND CONSTITUTION AMENDMENT BILLS HAVE NO JOINT-SITTING ROUTE.
EXAM USE: SITA SOREN (2024) PRESERVES INSTITUTIONAL INDEPENDENCE BY DENYING IMMUNITY THAT SUBVERTS IT.

sequence: Articles 108, 111 and 123 connect deadlock, assent, dissolution and temporary executive lawmaking.
Joint sitting resolves eligible deadlocks; dissolution selectively lapses Bills; ordinances return to Parliament.
Money and Constitution Amendment Bills have no joint-sitting route.

stages.title: BUDGET, GRANTS, FUNDS AND POWER OF THE PURSE

pills.text: ARTICLES 112-116 AND 266-267 CREATE AN AUTHORISATION-TO-AUDIT CHAIN FOR PUBLIC MONEY.
DISCLOSURE, GRANT VOTING, APPROPRIATION, EXPENDITURE AND CAG-PAC AUDIT FORM ONE CONTROL CYCLE.
CHARGED EXPENDITURE IS DISCUSSED NOT VOTED; PUBLIC ACCOUNT WITHDRAWAL NEEDS NO APPROPRIATION.
EXAM USE: ACCURATE CLASSIFICATION PREVENTS FISCAL PRIMACY FROM BECOMING AN UNINTENDED BICAMERAL BYPASS.

sequence: Articles 112-116 and 266-267 create an authorisation-to-audit chain for public money.
Disclosure, grant voting, appropriation, expenditure and CAG-PAC audit form one control cycle.
Charged expenditure is discussed not voted; Public Account withdrawal needs no appropriation.

stages.title: COMMITTEE ARCHITECTURE AND DETAILED SCRUTINY

pills.text: FINANCIAL COMMITTEES, DRSCS AND SPECIALISED COMMITTEES SUPPLY EVIDENCE-BASED SCRUTINY BEYOND THE FLOOR.
SMALL CROSS-HOUSE FORUMS EXAMINE ESTIMATES, AUDIT, BILLS AND MINISTRIES BEFORE REPORTING TO PARLIAMENT.
PAC, ESTIMATES AND COPU DIFFER IN COMPOSITION, TIME DIRECTION AND SUBJECT.
EXAM USE: THE MECHANISM CAN RESOLVE ORDINARY DEADLOCK WHILE PRESERVING SPECIAL PROCEDURES FOR MONEY AND AMENDMENT.

sequence: Financial committees, DRSCs and specialised committees supply evidence-based scrutiny beyond the floor.
Small cross-House forums examine estimates, audit, Bills and ministries before reporting to Parliament.
PAC, Estimates and CoPU differ in composition, time direction and subject.

stages.title: RAJYA SABHA, ANTI-DEFECTION AND BICAMERAL BALANCE

pills.text: RAJYA SABHA HAS GRADED POWERS WHILE THE TENTH SCHEDULE TRADES MEMBER AUTONOMY FOR STABILITY.
UPPER-HOUSE REVISION AND FEDERAL POWERS CHECK LOK SABHA, WHILE WHIPS SHAPE INDIVIDUAL VOTING.
RAJYA SABHA IS UNEQUAL ON MONEY AND CONFIDENCE, BUT EQUAL OR EXCLUSIVE ELSEWHERE.
EXAM USE: FORMAL INSTRUMENTS BECOME EFFECTIVE ONLY WHEN TIME, INFORMATION AND PARTY INCENTIVES PERMIT SCRUTINY.

Rajya Sabha is unequal on money and confidence, but equal or exclusive elsewhere.

stages.title: PARLIAMENTARY DECLINE, REFORM AND DIPLOMACY

pills.text: EXECUTIVE AGENDA CONTROL, TIME SCARCITY AND WIDE WHIPS WEAKEN USE OF OTHERWISE STRONG INSTRUMENTS.
MATCHED REFORMS IMPROVE CALENDAR, REFERRAL, RESEARCH, OPPOSITION TIME AND REASONED CHAIR DECISIONS.
INSTITUTIONAL DECLINE IS VARIABLE POLITICAL USE, NOT DISAPPEARANCE OF CONSTITUTIONAL POWER.
EXAM USE: STABILITY RISES, BUT DEBATE AND MEMBER-LEVEL SCRUTINY MAY WEAKEN WHEN WHIPS ARE OVERUSED.

sequence: Executive agenda control, time scarcity and wide whips weaken use of otherwise strong instruments.
Matched reforms improve calendar, referral, research, opposition time and reasoned chair decisions.
Institutional decline is variable political use, not disappearance of constitutional power.

NEVER SUBSTITUTE CURRENT-SENSITIVE NUMBERS OR PROPOSALS FOR STABLE CONSTITUTIONAL RULES.

items: A5. Concise source and current-control note
[ANALYSIS] “Parliamentary supremacy” in Indian GS-II questions usually means effective deliberative and control capacity, not unlimited legal sovereignty.
[FACT] Parliament cannot enact ordinary law beyond constitutional competence, and Article 368 itself is limited by the basic-structure doctrine.
[ANALYSIS] Cabinet dominance can marginalise Parliament without transferring constitutional sovereignty to the Cabinet.
